name: Comptoir 102
questions: Which bowls contain quinoa or oats?
Is the GF pizza base free of oats?
quinoa_oat_flags: Health café: protein bowls, granola and porridge may contain quinoa or oats. Ask about each dish.

safe_dishes.note: A blogger called them their favourite GF pancakes in Dubai. Buckwheat is wheat-free, but confirm no wheat flour is mixed in.
Ask for GF bread or none

summary: A Jumeirah health café praised for GF buckwheat pancakes, but likely to use quinoa and oats elsewhere on the menu.
